We’d be happy to help you choose—there are a few great ways to narrow it down:
Fit & comfort:
Originals: truer-to-size, snug rounded toe.
Classics: roomier fit, extra cushioning, extra footbeds.
Dress: sleeker look, runs long; usually size down.
Thermal/All‑Terrain: better for cold or rugged conditions.
Sizing help:
Use the True Fit / “Find My Size” button on any product page for a personalized size recommendation based on your current shoes and fit preferences.
Our size guide explains US vs AU/UK sizing and notes that half sizes add width, not length; go up a half size if you need a wider fit.
Try on in person:
You can visit one of our Blundstone shops (e.g., SoHo or Williamsburg in NY, Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles) or use the Store Locator to find nearby authorized retailers and get in‑person fit advice.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent. Based on this, we can absolutely help you choose the best series and size once you share how you’ll use the boots (daily city wear, dressy, winter, or hiking/light trails) and how you like them to fit (snug vs roomy).

Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

Sent · Just now

Blundstone · AI

Blundstone · AI says:

Our two most popular options are the Originals Series (e.g., #500) and the Classics Series (e.g., #550/#585).

Originals

Snug, true‑to‑size fit with rounded toe
Unlined (cotton/cambrelle) for breathability
2.5 mm premium leather, durable everyday all‑rounder

Classics

Roomier fit with extra toe height/width
Leather‑lined for more warmth and cushioning
Includes an extra footbed for customizable fit

Which is better for you?

Choose Originals if you want a slightly snugger, breathable, do‑everything boot and your feet are average width.
Choose Classics if you prefer more room and comfort, have wider feet, or plan to wear them for long days on your feet or in cooler conditions.

If you’re between fits or unsure on sizing, you can also use our sizing guidance and consider going up a half size for extra width; Classics and some Kids/Youth styles include extra insoles to fine‑tune the fit.
